payload.title: M1 TTAB decisions monitor
payload.description: Daily poll of the USPTO TTAB Reading Room API: rolling 30-day window (decisions appear about two weeks after issuance), dedupe on documentId, precedential re-check over the last 90-180 days, identifying User-Agent and about one request a second. Output: pending references for the Rulings section, keyed by proceeding number, with the opinion PDF.
